cause_quote: The introducing diff sets `failed` when `error || (environment && environment.status !== "starting" && environment.status !== "available")` and uses `failed ? "portalsPage.environmentUnavailable"` to display “The machine could not start.”
user_saw: The Portal panel said the device could not start when its status check failed or the device was stopping or unavailable.
summary: The fix gives failed status checks, stopping devices, and unavailable devices distinct messages and relabels the status retry button “Check again.”
reasoning: I traced the message back to the commit that introduced the Portal device panel and checked that its `environments.status` catch handler fed errors directly into the startup-failure branch. Later refactors carried that logic forward, and the November copy change retained the startup diagnosis.
